description: This file defines the AWS CognitoSyncClient class, which serves as a client for interacting with the Amazon Cognito Sync service. It contains method annotations for various API operations, both synchronous and asynchronous, that the client supports.

classes.name: CognitoSyncClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon Cognito Sync service, extending the base AwsClient functionality.

methods.name: bulkPublish
methods.description: Method to perform bulk publishing of datasets in Cognito Sync.

methods.name: deleteDataset
methods.description: Deletes a dataset in Cognito Sync.

methods.name: describeIdentityPoolUsage
methods.description: Gets usage information for an identity pool.

methods.name: describeIdentityUsage
methods.description: Describes usage information for an identity.

methods.name: getBulkPublishDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details about the bulk publish operation.

methods.name: getIdentityPoolConfiguration
methods.description: Gets configuration for an identity pool.

methods.name: listDatasets
methods.description: Lists datasets associated with an identity.

methods.name: listIdentityPoolUsage
methods.description: Lists usage information for identity pools.

methods.name: setIdentityPoolConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration for an identity pool.
